blueprints.accuracy_notes: Real photograph, centred straight-on front view; mild perspective (not orthographic). Good for headlight/apron/intake layout of the 991.1 Carrera (Bi-Xenon, slim LED apron strips, three intakes).
Straight-on rear photo with mild perspective; shows slim separate LED taillights, horizontal-louvre grille, single oval tailpipe each side (Carrera).
Overhead photo (slight perspective); useful for plan-view waist, mirrors on doors, grille, fuel flap on right front wing.
NOT to scale: image L/WB = 1.728 vs true 4491/2450 = 1.833 (perspective shrinks the ends ~6 %). Use for shapes/feature placement only.

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
